records.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` is wrapped in a `try/catch` that only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` and then proceeds to `return { message: "Guests added" }`. records.issue_text: booking.userId == null causes findFirstOrThrow to throw unhandled Prisma error resulting in a 500 instead of a TRPCError
records.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, organizer is fetched via `prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { id: booking.userId || 0 } })`. If `booking.userId` is `null/undefined`, this coerces to `0`, and `findFirstOrThrow` will throw a Prisma not-found error that is not caught/translated to a `TRPCError`, resulting in a 500. The diff shows no guard or try/catch around this call.

records.issue_text: showToast error path renders raw/undefined error string to users; fallback message is dead code since template string is always truthy
records.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog` `onError`, `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` will always produce a truthy string (even if `err.data?.code` is `undefined`, yielding e.g. `"undefined: ..."`). Therefore `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` never reaches the fallback, and users may see an `undefined:` prefix / raw error details.
